svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make eight. Ring 120 outside, 56 inside, 2 thick, printed flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three 5.5 mm holes on an 84 mm circle, 120 degrees apart; one of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: them on the line from the centre toward the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: White plastic reflects the sun; do not paint or use another colour.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make 24 spacers too: 8 mm outside, 5.5 mm bore, 21 of them 11 long

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 3 of them 9 long (the top row, under the cap).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stack: plate, 11 spacer, plate ... 8 plates, then the 9 spacers and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the cap, all on three M5 rods, 13 mm from plate to plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the stack is 13 mm pitch, plates parallel, gaps open.
